rule: Recommendation weights cannot move until accepted, ignored, rejected, stale, rollback, and blocked outcomes are scored in a visible evaluation lab with human approval and payment-custody routes blocked.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody outcome can change recommendation weights in phase one.
evaluation_principles: Score outcomes before changing recommendation weights.
Reward accepted actions only when proof, response, and approval are visible.
Reduce confidence for ignored, rejected, stale, or contradicted recommendations.
Keep rollback state beside every positive and negative weight delta.
Separate tenant-private evaluation from anonymized aggregate evaluation.
Show blocked payment-custody routes as zero-weight signals.
Require human approval before evaluated learning changes the next operational recommendation.

role_evaluation_labs.accepted_signal: direct enquiry copied and supplier replied
role_evaluation_labs.ignored_signal: verified supplier shown but no buyer action
role_evaluation_labs.rejected_signal: proof mismatch or route not trusted

role_evaluation_labs.ignored_signal: listing guidance viewed but not updated
role_evaluation_labs.rejected_signal: proof failed review or response route blocked

role_evaluation_labs.accepted_signal: market wedge approved and supplier route opened
role_evaluation_labs.rejected_signal: proof density or response reliability failed
role_evaluation_labs.stale_signal: market signal aged out before approval
